description: This file implements an Android ContentProvider for managing notes, providing CRUD operations with a SQLite database backend.

classes.name: NotesContentProvider
classes.description: An Android ContentProvider that exposes note data stored in a SQLite database, handling CRUD operations via URI matching.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the database helper upon creation of the content provider.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles query requests to retrieve note data based on the URI pattern.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the data at the given URI.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new note record into the database and notifies change.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes note records based on the URI and selection criteria.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing note records in the database based on the URI.
